newsitem.title: USA: Linear sees further sequential growth.
newsitem.headline: Linear sees further sequential growth.

text.p: Linear Technology Corp said Tuesday that strength across all its markets, particularly communications, should allow it to record sequential growth in the coming quarter.
Earlier the company posted results for the third quarter.
"We resumed our sequential growth in sales and profits after three flat quarters," said Robert Swanson, president and chief executive officer.

The company said in a statement that in order to meet anticipated demand in the coming quarter it has begun production operations in its new Camas, Washington wafer fabrication facility which will be ramped up over the next few quarters. The company will also be ramping up its Milpitas fab, Penang assembly and Singapore test operations.

The company had third quarter earnings of $33.9 million, or $0.43 a share on revenues of $95 million. In the year-ago quarter the company had profits of $37.7 million, or $0.48 a share, on revenues of $104.7 million. While the results for the quarter were below those of the comparable year-ago quarter they beat those of the previous quarter.
